Title: Generally Available: DLT with serverless compute

Body.Content: DLT with serverless compute allows you to run your streaming data pipelines without configuring and deploying infrastructure. With DLT with serverless compute, Azure Databricks efficiently manages the compute resources required to run your streaming pipelines, including optimizing and scaling them. Additionally, DLT with serverless compute offers capabilities like incremental refresh for materialized views and stream pipelining that can significantly improve cost and performance. See the details for DLT Serverless here.
